Campaign.title: Campaign
Campaign.description: Multi-session RPG campaign campaign settings, summary, characters, list of sessions, and details managed by the Dungeon Master.

setting.description: RPG system, game world setting, mythology, or flavor details

description.description: Short description of the campaign arc

Session.title: Session
Session.description: Dungeon Master game session containing raw notes, audio recordings, summarizations, visual highlights, and video links.

campaignId.description: Parent Campaign ID linking this session to a specific campaign

date.description: The date when the session occurred

audioUrl.description: Link to recorded audio session or audio note, if any

audioTranscription.description: The transcribed audio, if uploaded and parsed

summary.description: AI-generated summary and bulleted key points

videoUrl.description: Url to the short Veo-generated video

videoOperationName.description: Operation path for polling the Veo generation

videoStatus.description: Veo generation status: idle, generating, done, or error

highlights.description: An array of highlight items, each with an image URL and a brief caption description

campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Collection of Dungeon Master campaigns, scoped by owners ID

sessions/{sessionId}.description: Collection of Dungeon Master game sessions, scoped by owner ID
